acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Werebeasts family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Primal Beast-King, T5, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Rune-Break Transformation Sovereign (Sovereign) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two wind construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Dire-scaled bulk, storm-like mane, horn-and-antler crown grown from the skull, and shattered binding runes floating around the body.

Signature mechanic: Arena Transformation — Four Broken Bindings: the horn-and-antler crown points to one floating rune, the rune shatters, and an Afflicted, Half-turned, Werebeast, or Alpha performs its learned hunt before the King's matching limb fully transforms.
battlefieldDuty: Transform a four-quadrant hunting arena by shattering one binding rune and commanding a learned lower-form hunt in each phase.
constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 patchy fur and long fingers carry tiny torn-seam vanes; T2 the emerging muzzle and hybrid shoulders gain cheek pressure channels; T3 digitigrade hocks and mature claws gain directional fur lanes; T4 the broken chain and iron collar gain calibrated air links; T5 the horn-and-antler crown and broken runes gain pressure-route sockets.

Motion/process branches: T1 a sweep with long fingers drives the torn seam tabs around one still wrist; T2 the hybrid pounce follows a muzzle-side pressure channel; T3 digitigrade crosscuts reverse directional fur flow; T4 chain rotation circles a still collar anchor; T5 each crown rune redirects one commanded debris vector.
counterplay: Solve the announced lower-form lesson, then strike the exposed crown root before the limb locks; each restored binding removes one hunt and reduces the final transformation. Affinity signal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 the patchy-fur torn seam reveals a still wrist between vane sweeps; T2 the hybrid muzzle channel leaves one still shoulder after the pounce; T3 a digitigrade landing exposes the claw-lane pressure anchor; T4 the chain-and-collar still link appears after a full rotation; T5 the crown rune exposes its pressure socket between commanded vectors.
identityInvariants: A human frame progressively stretches toward animal proportions while hands, shoulders, legs, muzzle, and tail change at explicit tiers.
Grey, black, russet, or silver fur remains distinct from torn muted human clothing, hide, iron restraints, claw, and fang.
Shredded dress, snapped restraints, ritual scars, and restrained moon motifs record the unfinished transformation without defining an affinity.
Loss of human proportion escalates from patchy changes to an authored sovereign transformation while readable joints remain exposed.
telegraph: One crown tine aligns with a binding rune, its fracture travels toward the matching limb, and the lower form assumes its familiar starting posture.
